column1: # q16: SQL functions beside the calculation functions of the same name, same
# arguments. File: FileMaker Server sample (en), no record context. Each pair:
ExecuteSQLe ( "SELECT COS(1), SIN(1), TAN(1), ATAN(1), DEGREES(1), RADIANS(180), PI() FROM Tasks WHERE \"TASK ID MATCH FIELD\" = 3" ; "|" ; "¶" )
ExecuteSQLe ( "SELECT EXP(1), LN(10), LOG(2), LG(100), SQRT(2), 2^0.5, EXP(2.5) FROM Tasks WHERE \"TASK ID MATCH FIELD\" = 3" ; "|" ; "¶" )

ExecuteSQLe ( "SELECT ROUND(2.5, 0), ROUND(-2.5, 0), ROUND(0.125, 2), INT(-2.7), CEILING(-1.2), FLOOR(-1.2), MOD(-7, 3), MOD(7, -3), MOD(7, 0), SIGN(-3) FROM Tasks WHERE \"TASK ID MATCH FIELD\" = 3" ; "|" ; "¶" )
ExecuteSQLe ( "SELECT 1/3, 10/3, 1/7, 2/3, 1/3000000, 123456789.123456789 * 1000 FROM Tasks WHERE \"TASK ID MATCH FIELD\" = 3" ; "|" ; "¶" )
Length ( "👍🏽" ) & "|" & Length ( "🇩🇪" ) & "|" & Length ( "e" & Char ( 769 ) ) & "|" & Length ( "😀" ) & "|" & Upper ( "straße" ) & "|" & Lower ( "ΣΑΣ" ) & "|" & Upper ( "ǆ" ) & "|" & Lower ( "İ" )
ExecuteSQLe ( "SELECT LENGTH('👍🏽'), LENGTH('🇩🇪'), LENGTH('é'), LENGTH('😀'), UPPER('straße'), LOWER('ΣΑΣ'), UPPER('ǆ'), LOWER('İ') FROM Tasks WHERE \"TASK ID MATCH FIELD\" = 3" ; "|" ; "¶" )
ExecuteSQLe ( "SELECT LEFT('😀ab', 1), SUBSTR('😀abc', 2, 2), RIGHT('ab😀', 1), SUBSTR('Hire New', 0, 3) FROM Tasks WHERE \"TASK ID MATCH FIELD\" = 3" ; "|" ; "¶" )
DayName ( Date ( 11 ; 24 ; 2014 ) ) & "|" & MonthName ( Date ( 11 ; 24 ; 2014 ) ) & "|" & DayOfWeek ( Date ( 11 ; 24 ; 2014 ) )
ExecuteSQLe ( "SELECT DAYNAME(DATE '2014-11-24'), MONTHNAME(DATE '2014-11-24'), DAYOFWEEK(DATE '2014-11-24') FROM Tasks WHERE \"TASK ID MATCH FIELD\" = 3" ; "|" ; "¶" )
ExecuteSQLe ( "SELECT 1e20, 10^9, 1000000000.5, 0.0000000001, .5, 1.50 FROM Tasks WHERE \"TASK ID MATCH FIELD\" = 3" ; "|" ; "¶" )
